facts.text: Millikin University's Big Blue Pledge covers 100% of students' undergraduate tuition in their first year by combining Millikin grants and scholarships with available state and federal grants.

sources.title: Big Blue Pledge | Millikin University
sources.quote: The Big Blue Pledge will cover 100% of students' undergraduate tuition by combining Millikin grants and scholarships with available state and federal grants, in their first year at Millikin.
